name: Announce every new YouTube video on your social accounts with Socialync

parameters.content:
### How it works
When your YouTube channel publishes a video, this workflow announces it on the other platforms you use. It reads the channel feed, picks the HD thumbnail when YouTube has one, and builds an image post with a caption that fits each platform. Socialync checks the post first and leaves out any platform that cannot take it, such as an account that needs a reconnect. The platforms that pass are scheduled. The video ID is the idempotency key, so a repeated call within 24 hours does not announce the video twice.

Posts are scheduled without a manual approval step. You can cancel or change any scheduled post in Socialync until it goes out.

### Setup
1. Create an API key at https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node-keys and add it as a Socialync credential.
2. Replace the channel ID in the feed address of the trigger. The channel ID starts with UC. YouTube shows it in your channel's advanced settings.
3. In Settings, choose the platforms and the intro line. Connect those platforms in Socialync first.
4. Publish a test video or use an older channel to run it once.

### Customization
Change the intro line, the Instagram link line and the delay in Settings. Instagram needs an image, and this workflow sends one. It sends image posts, and TikTok and YouTube need a video, so it leaves them out.

API reference: https://socialync.io/go/n8n-node

parameters.content:
## Watch the channel
Each new video starts one run. Settings holds the platforms and the intro line.

## Build the post
The HD thumbnail and a caption for each platform. Shorter text for Bluesky, Threads and X.

## Check, then schedule
Socialync checks the post. Platforms that pass are scheduled, the rest are named in the output.

## Channel ID
Replace the channel ID in the feed address before you run anything.
